feature.pages.description: Wiki pages, categories, navigation, search and images.
feature.pages.name: Pages
js.pages.crop_external: Images from other sites cannot be cropped: upload the image to the wiki.
js.pages.crop_failed: The image could not be cropped.
js.pages.crop_gif: GIFs are not cropped here: they would lose their animation.
js.pages.crop_hint: Drag the corners to crop. The crop is uploaded as a new image; the original stays.
js.pages.crop_no_upload: Cropping needs permission to upload images.
js.pages.crop_unavailable: The image cannot be shown here.
js.pages.image_changed: The text has changed: open the image again.
js.pages.image_not_found: This image cannot be found in the text: put the cursor on it and press Image.
js.pages.image_pick: Put the cursor on an image in the text, or click an image in the preview.
js.pages.video_invalid: Enter a YouTube or Vimeo address starting with https://.
js.pages.not_an_image: {name} is not a picture: only pictures go into the text.
pages.blocked.pending_deletion: This page is pending deletion and cannot be changed.
pages.category.delete_uncategorize: Keep its pages without a category
pages.category.empty: This category has no pages yet.
pages.category.sequential_hint: Show links to the previous and next page at the bottom of each page.
pages.confirm.hide: Hide this page from navigation and search?
pages.confirm.set_home: Make this page the home page?
pages.confirm.unhide: Show this page in navigation and search again?
pages.conflict.body: {user} saved this page while you were editing. Your text is still in the editor: merge the changes below, then save again to replace their version.
pages.conflict.diff_coarse: The two versions are too different to compare in detail: part of the text is shown as removed and added again as a whole.
pages.conflict.diff_hint: Struck-through text is only in their version; highlighted text is only in yours.
pages.conflict.title: Someone else saved this page
pages.create.title: New page
pages.edit.title: Editing {title}
pages.editor.crop_area: Area to keep: drag it or move it with the arrow keys
pages.editor.drop_hint: Drop or paste images to upload them.
pages.editor.image_alt_hint: Describes the image to people who cannot see it, for example with a screen reader.
pages.editor.image_float_hint: With Left and Right the text that follows flows beside the image, which takes at most half the page; on small screens the image goes above the text.
pages.editor.image_title: Upload an image, or change the one at the cursor
pages.editor.image_title_edit: Change the image at the cursor
pages.editor.video_hint: YouTube and Vimeo links are supported.
pages.error.category_not_writable: You cannot put pages in that category.
pages.error.category_pages_blocked: The category was not deleted. These pages cannot be deleted right now: {titles}
pages.error.category_pages_forbidden: The category was not deleted. You may not delete these pages: {titles}
pages.error.category_pages_hidden: The category was not deleted: it holds pages you cannot see.
pages.error.choose_target: Choose the category that should receive the pages.
pages.error.home_fixed: The home page cannot be moved or given another address.
pages.error.navigation_changed: The navigation changed. Reload the page and try again.
pages.error.not_siblings: Only categories with the same parent can be reordered together.
pages.error.upload_in_use: That image is still used; it was not deleted.
pages.field.title: Title
pages.flash.conflict: The page changed while you were editing. Review the differences before saving.
pages.flash.hidden: The page is now hidden from navigation and search.
pages.flash.renamed: Address changed; links in other pages were updated.
pages.flash.unhidden: The page is visible in navigation and search again.
pages.hint.no_metadata: You may edit the content but not the title or category.
pages.hint.slug: Letters, digits and hyphens. Links from other pages are updated automatically.
pages.nav.title: Pages
pages.order.hint: Drag pages and categories, or use the arrows, to change their order.
pages.search.scope.title: Titles
pages.search.sort.title: Title
pages.search.syntax: Use "quotes" for phrases, -word to exclude, and title:, content:, category:, slug: or type:page to narrow the search.
pages.search.title: Search
pages.seq.label: Previous and next page
pages.summary.page_builder: Updated with the visual page builder
pages.sync.updated: This page was changed by someone else.
pages.toc.title: Contents
pages.upload.quota_bytes: You reached your daily upload limit of {limit_mb} MB. Try again tomorrow.
pages.upload.quota_count: You reached your daily upload limit ({count}). Try again tomorrow.
pages.view.empty: This page has no content yet.
pages.welcome.body: Choose a page below or from the navigation. Only the categories you can open are shown.
pages.bm.simple_editor_hint: Keeps bold, italic, headings, lists, links and pictures; hides code, quotes, tables, videos and the edit summary.
pages.bm.simple_actions_hint: Hides changing a page's address and hiding a page from lists.
pages.bm.simple_reading_hint: Hides the link to a page's history next to its author and in its actions; the history stays at its address.
pages.bm.simple_sidebar_hint: The sidebar shows the pages and categories, Kanban boards and canvases; other apps (people, messages, the leaderboard, reservations, plugins' apps) leave it but stay at their addresses.
wiki.error.cannot_delete_home: The home page cannot be deleted.
wiki.error.category_cycle: A category cannot be moved inside itself.
wiki.error.category_name_too_long: Category names are at most {limit} characters long.
wiki.error.content_too_long: The page is too long (1 MB at most).
wiki.error.edit_conflict: Someone else saved this page in the meantime.
wiki.error.slug_taken: Another page already uses that address.
wiki.error.title_too_long: Titles are at most {limit} characters long.
